campus: Viterbo - Santa Maria in Gradi (Headquarter). Remote learning available (up to two-thirds of the course, per departmental policy).
academic_requirements: First-cycle (bachelor's) degree of 180 CFU. Preferred classes: L-14, L-16, L-36, L-37, L-40, L-42, or LMG-01 (or recognized foreign equivalent). Applicants from other classes must have at least 60 of the 180 CFU in the legal group (IUS/01-21) PLUS credits in at least one of: political-social sciences (SPS/01,04,07,08,09,11,12); economic-statistical (M-GGR/02, SECS-P/01,02,03,05,06, SECS-S/01,03,04,05); history (M-STO/02,03,04, SECS-P/04,12, SPS/02,03,06); or language (L-LIN/04,07,12,14). A tolerance of up to 10% on required CFU thresholds is allowed. Access requirements (curricular adequacy) are verified via the oral interview. Source: didactic regulation PDF (2023/24 edition, still current as of 2026/09 check) at https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Reg.to-did.-Human-r.-LM-90.pdf
language_requirements: English at CEFR level B2, demonstrated by certificate or verified during the mandatory admission interview (which is conducted in English). No Italian language requirement, since the programme is delivered entirely in English.
entry_exam_or_test: Mandatory oral interview in English (in person or remote), administered by the Didactic Commission, which also determines how any missing curricular credits/requirements must be made up. No TOLC, no written entrance exam. Admission form for a.y. 2026/2027 (International students only): https://forms.gle/YWhb4aASrJAEsnuX8
application_deadline_eu: No programme-specific application deadline published (rolling admission via online form + interview). University-wide enrolment window 2026-08-01 to 2026-12-29 for 1st-year Master's students (academic year 2026/2027), with an extension to 2027-02-28 for January/February graduates.
application_deadline_non_eu: No programme-specific deadline published. Same rolling process as EU applicants (admission form + interview), within the university enrolment window 2026-08-01 to 2026-12-29 (1st-year Master's, a.y. 2026/2027). Non-EU visa application cutoff at the Italian consulate: 2026-11-30. Universitaly pre-enrolment for non-EU students applying from abroad is open for a.y. 2026/2027 (typically opens April/May).
required_documents: No programme-specific required-documents list is published on this course's official pages. Falling back to the university-wide Universitaly/enrolment document baseline: (1) secondary school diploma (certified copy + apostille/legalization + certified Italian translation, OR CIMEA Statement of Verification); (2) bachelor's degree of at least 3 years (same legalization options); (3) Transcript of Records; (4) Declaration of Value (consulate) OR CIMEA Statement of Comparability OR ARDI Statement of Correspondence; (5) Diploma Supplement (can replace Declaration of Value if legalized); (6) English-language certificate or EMI (English as Medium of Instruction) attestation; (7) admission letter; (8) completed a.y. 2026/2027 admission form (International students only): https://forms.gle/YWhb4aASrJAEsnuX8.

tuition_or_fees_link.note: University-wide ISEEUP-based tuition model. Regulations PDF: https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/TUITION-FEES-AND-CONTRIBUTIONS-REGULATIONS_2026-2027.pdf. Non-EU flat-fee bands (for students not declaring ISEEUP), by country group: EUR 600 / 1,050 / 1,500 / 1,950 per year (see country annex: https://www.unitus.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/All.1_-Paesi_studenti-internazionali_2026_2027.pdf). Simulator: https://www.unitus.it/en/students/fees-and-contributions/tuition-fee-simulator/. Visa financial-means requirement: EUR 10,179.85/year.

source_quotes.quote: First level degree (180 credits), knowledge of English at least equal to level B2 (CEFR) verifies the possession of the access requirements through an interview in the language.
